newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in Kansas on Monday. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry moderate, demand fair, USDA said.
Sales confirmed on 700 slaughter steers and 1,000 slaughter heifers Monday. For the week to date 11,400 head confirmed, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1375 lbs $65.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1075 lbs
$65.00; pen Select with end Choice 975 lbs $64.00.
